_meta.what: Bonuses printed on Global summon banner art that the banner data did not carry. banner_deals.py adds them at load time; data a banner already has always wins.
_meta.source: Read by hand from the banner art (FFBE wiki Gacha-*.png), 2026-11-05.
_meta.guesses: Choice weights for "free 3★/4★/5★ Trust Moogles" are not printed on the art: 3★ 70%, 4★ 25%, 5★ 5% (1★ 60%, 3★ 30%, 4★ 10% for the 2017 summer banner). A 3★ "random trust mastery" moogle is a 5% moogle for one of the banner's featured units. Percentages not printed use 1★ 1%, 4★ 5%, 5★ 10%, as printed on the 2018 banners.
